title: Francisco Pérez Latre (Professor, Universidad de Navarra) cites the book on incoherence at work — 'As that belief erodes, cynicism takes root'
summary: A communications chair at the Universidad de Navarra, who writes on trust and work, puts ethics at the centre of the workplace and quotes the book on what incoherence costs a company — citing the page. He calls it a book that makes you think.
blockquote: at an incoherent company, employees stop believing that what they joined to do is possible. As that belief erodes, cynicism takes root
blockquote_source: Incorruptible, p. 153, quoted by Francisco Pérez Latre on X
attribution_title: Professor of Communication, Universidad de Navarra
